_doc: Language pack — keyword DATA for parsing a free-form SRS (which is in the user's language). The engine loads `en` as the base, then merges the project's `config.language` pack on top (union of keywords). Add `<lang>.json` here (or in a project's .spec-flow/templates/lang/) to support a new language; no engine change needed. This covers ONLY SRS parsing — the generated SD keeps canonical-English structure, so SD-side table parsing stays hardcoded.
